chunker.description: The {@link Genai.SourceFile}s are chunked by the {@link Genai.SourceFile.Chunker}.

specType.description: The spec type for the chunker {@link Genai.SourceFile.Chunker}.

textSplitters.description: List of spec for the text splitters used with chunker.

replaceCodeRefIfValidTokenLen.description:
If true, the chunker will replace code references with the original code snippet if the token length is less than
maxTokens.

badChars.description:
List of strings that can be passed as bad characters apart from the hardcoded list of bad
characters in replaceBadChars(). These specified characters will be removed from the passages
and will be replaced by empty string

fileExtToChunkerSpecMap.description:
Mapping of file extensions to chunker specs. If a file extension is not found in this map, the default chunker spec is used.
Default chunker spec {@link Genai.SourceFile.Chunker.UniversalChunker.DefaultConfig} extracts and chunks the content of the document based on the configuration of each
document type.

title:
Genai.SourceFile.Chunker.UniversalChunker.Spec mixes {@link Genai.SourceFile.ChunkerSpec} to add new field
which enables overridding mapping of file extensions to chunker specs.
name: Genai.SourceFile.Chunker.UniversalChunker.Spec
